input: hi! hosting wigilia in warsaw for 8 people (my parents, in-laws, kids), first one since my babcia passed. i want to make carp exactly like she did - fried carp as the main fish and karp w galarecie. has to be polish farmed carp, not imported or another fish, about 4 kg so theres enough for both. it needs to be properly fresh, the way babcia always got it, like every christmas eve when i was a kid - my dad will notice. i'll prepare it all at home the traditonal way. needs to arrive in mokotów on 23 dec, total under 300 zł with shipping. can you order it?

experiences.name: Praska Spiżarnia Wigilia Barszcz & Uszka Set for 8
experiences.description: Deep ruby barszcz concentrate in glass jars and hand-made uszka filled with wild forest mushrooms, enough for eight bowls on Christmas Eve. Made in our small kitchen in Warsaw's Praga from an egg-free dough; the uszka arrive frozen, ready to drop into simmering barszcz. Delivered 23 December.

experiences.name: Gospodarstwo Rybne Dolina Baryczy – Traditional Wigilia Live Carp (2 × ~2 kg)
experiences.description: The Christmas Eve carp just as Polish families have always bought it. Two whole mirror carp of about 2 kg each, raised in earthen ponds in the Barycz Valley and harvested in early December. The fish arrive alive in water-filled plastic bags; keep them in a bathtub or tub and kill them at home before cleaning and cooking. Courier delivery on 23 December, 9:00–14:00, anywhere in Warsaw. Price includes delivery.

experiences.name: Gospodarstwo Rybne Karpiowa Grobla – Whole Wigilia Carp, Gutted & Scaled (2 × ~2 kg)
experiences.description: Two whole Polish mirror carp of about 2 kg each from earthen ponds in the Milicz area, gutted and scaled and ready for your Christmas Eve kitchen. The carp are electrically stunned and slaughtered at the farm's processing plant on the morning of dispatch, then packed on ice in an insulated box. Fillet them for frying; head and bones come packed separately for the galareta stock. Courier delivery on 23 December, 9:00–14:00, anywhere in Warsaw. Price includes delivery.

experiences.name: Pierogarnia Na Skarpie – Pierogi z Kapustą i Grzybami + Kutia
experiences.description: Forty-eight hand-pinched pierogi filled with sauerkraut and forest mushrooms, made with plant-based dough and fillings, plus a generous bowl of kutia for 8 with wheat, poppy seed, honey and chopped nuts. Two Wigilia classics, ready to warm and serve. Chilled delivery on 23 December.

experiences.name: Rybarnia Pod Kasztanem – Christmas Carp, Sent Live in Oxygen Bag
experiences.description: Christmas carp at its very freshest, a Warsaw staple from our neighbourhood fish counter: Polish carp from a pond farm near Zator in Małopolska, about 4 kg in total, enough for both the fried course and the galareta. The carp travel alive in an oxygenated plastic bag; keep them in water at home and kill them yourself before cooking. Delivered by app courier in an insulated crate, 23 December evening slot. Price includes Warsaw delivery.

experiences.name: Gospodarstwo Rybackie Nad Skawą – Christmas Carp Set, Frying Portions + Aspic Frames (4 kg)
experiences.description: Everything for the carp courses of a Wigilia table: Polish carp portions for frying plus carp heads and frames for karp w galarecie, 4 kg in total. The carp, from ponds near Zator, are percussively stunned and slaughtered at the farm's processing plant the day before delivery. Cook them at home in the time-honoured way. Vacuum-packed portions travel on ice by refrigerated van to Warsaw on 23 December, 16:00–20:00. Price includes delivery.

experiences.name: Piekarnia Żoliborska – Makowiec & Kompot z Suszu Bundle
experiences.description: A rich Christmas poppy-seed roll baked on 22 December at our Żoliborz bakery from a plant-based recipe, paired with two 1.5 l bottles of kompot z suszu made from smoked dried plums, apples and pears simmered with spices. The sweet finish to Christmas Eve, delivered 23 December.
